# What the Model Doesn't Know {#sec-what-the-model-doesnt-know}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "it knows everything" — training data has a cutoff and a
domain, and confidence is not knowledge.

Installs: hallucination as a property, not a bug; the cost of asking
for facts the model cannot have. Working build: a question the model
gets confidently wrong, then the same question with the answer pasted
into the prompt.
:::
